rationale: Crosses the render-assets-and-backends watch family only through the broad core/view/** selector. The Pulp-owned change replaces the single active-overlay slot with a per-root overlay STACK so a submenu and the menu that opened it can both be tracked, paints the open-overlay branch last at every level between it and the root so a sibling cannot draw over an open menu, and routes a press down the stack so an outside press closes one level instead of reaching the content beneath. Paint ordering changes only when an overlay is claimed; the ordinary frame is gated behind a process-wide live-claim count and is byte-identical. It adds no renderer, canvas, Skia, Dawn, asset, layout, or authority behavior, and the per-root ownership that keeps two hosted editors independent is preserved. Regressions are confined to test/test_overlay_routing.cpp. No accepted expansion boundary moves, no Vellum implementation is changed, and no generated artifact or manifest row moves. Registered watch-only so the family's coverage stays explicit about this core/view paint-order change.
